answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37251 Country: India Title: I need to know whether jama bainas salatain is correct as I am a frequent traveler and I offer Zuhr and Asr together and Maghrib and Isha Question: I need to know whether jama bainas salatain is correct as I am a frequent traveler and I offer Zuhr and Asr together and Maghrib and Isha due to availability of time and place during traveling. Answer ID: 37251 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 527/260/L=1433) It is not lawful to combine two salah at the same time instead of Arafah and Muzdalifah. However, in case of compulsion they may be offered together in a way, for example Zuhr is offered at its last time and Asr is offered at its starting time. Likewise consider the other salah as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
